findings.title: Model-backed environment agent can read and transmit the entire ~/.claude tree
findings.where: .claude/agents/env-skills.md:4 grants Read and Bash, while lines 8-15 authorize read/edit access to ~/.claude/**; lines 29-31 acknowledge credentials, keys, and JSONL runtime data but protect them only from Git inclusion.
findings.what: Read results become context for the configured Sonnet model. The blanket ~/.claude/** authority therefore permits subscription-OAuth model calls to carry session history, credentials, keys, or other ~/.claude-derived content. Gitignore exclusion prevents commits, not LLM egress, so it does not satisfy ADR 0008's prohibition.
findings.fix: Replace the blanket ~/.claude/** read authority with an explicit allowlist of source-controlled configuration directories/files and add a hard prohibition on reading credentials, keys, JSONL/history, projects, telemetry, caches, and other runtime data. Require redacted/local inspection for any exceptional diagnostic need and forbid placing such content in model context.
findings.acceptance: A static review of this agent definition shows no blanket ~/.claude/** read grant; it explicitly excludes .credentials.json, keys, *.jsonl, history/projects/runtime data, and states that subscription-OAuth model context must never contain ~/.claude-derived secrets or session content. A harness-level permission test must deny attempted reads of representative excluded files while allowing the documented configuration allowlist.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read baseline lines 1-32. The scope repeatedly says the agent owns and may read/edit the entire ~/.claude tree, while the only stated safeguard is Git ignore/force-add behavior. No egress restriction, read denylist, or redaction boundary appears in the audited file; the candidate is therefore current and directly reproducible from the configured authority.
